name: Han Market
kicker: The market hall beside the swing bridge
summary: Shop the two-floor market hall beside the swing bridge for fish sauce, dried central-coast food, fruit, fabric, and an áo dài sewn to order and ready within the hour. Give it an hour on a river morning, and eat in the food zone while you are there.
getThere: 119 Tran Phu, beside the swing bridge. Walk from Bach Dang.
heroCaption: The Cho Han entrance on Tran Phu

notice.title: Ask the price first
notice.body: Stalls do not post prices. Agree the price before an áo dài is cut or a bag is packed.

body: Use Han Market when you are already on the river. The hall sits beside the swing bridge at 119 Tran Phu, with sides on Tran Phu, Bach Dang, and Hung Vuong. It was rebuilt in 1990 on two floors, about 3,000 square meters.

The hall sells fresh seafood, fruit, fish sauce, and dried central-coast food. The clothes side has shoes, bags, fabric, souvenirs, and tailors who sew an áo dài to order and have it ready within the hour. Eat in the food zone, then walk out to Bach Dang.
Con Market, around Hung Vuong and Ong Ich Khiem, is the city's other big hall.

figures.caption: The produce wing inside Cho Han
figures.alt: Fruit and vegetable stalls in the Han Market produce hall

gettingThere: The hall is at 119 Tran Phu, beside the swing bridge, on the block bounded by Tran Phu, Bach Dang, Hung Vuong, and Nguyen Thai Hoc (Nguyen Van Linh on the 2023 listing). Walk from a river hotel. From My Khe, come by Grab.

legs.heading: From Bach Dang
legs.body: Walk to 119 Tran Phu. The Bach Dang side of the hall is the food way in.

hours: 06:00–19:00 (city markets page, 9 Oct 2023). No hours on the 28 Sep 2024 page. Check on arrival.
admissionNote: No gate fee. Stall and tailoring prices: check on arrival.
